context: Tests that review closes on evidence rather than round counts: fixed and rejected findings reach a terminal state, contract-changing fixes get one refreshed review, clerical edits and unrequested work get none, and session length never stops authorized work.

checklist.name: No round-count stop
checklist.description: Case A does not stop, pause delivery, or ask the user because of the number of review rounds, fix commits, or session length

checklist.name: Repeated finding rejected
checklist.description: Case A keeps the repeated finding rejected, citing the recorded evidence, and does not reopen it or rerun review to settle it

checklist.name: Refresh scoped to contract change
checklist.description: Case A refreshes independent review once on the final head because the fix changed an authentication contract, using the same provider and mode

checklist.name: Clerical edit inspected directly
checklist.description: Case A treats the comment typo as a clerical edit that needs direct inspection, not its own review

checklist.name: Terminal condition stated
checklist.description: Case A states that closeout is reached when the refreshed review has no findings or every finding is fixed and verified or rejected, then proceeds to delivery

checklist.name: Proof revision kept
checklist.description: Case A ties the regression and required-check evidence to the head they ran on

checklist.name: No unrequested review
checklist.description: Case B delivers without independent review; an installed CLI and provider do not create a review requirement
